name: LoongClock
summary: LoongClock is a non-trading utility EA that displays a clock on the chart. It uses a timer event to update the clock every second and supports both local and server time sources via a configurable input parameter.
summary_zh: LoongClock是一个非交易的实用工具EA，在图表上显示时钟。它使用定时器事件每秒更新时钟，并支持通过可配置输入参数选择本地时间或服务器时间源。
strategy_analysis: 此EA不涉及任何交易策略，它是一个纯工具类EA，用于在图表上显示时钟。入场条件、出场条件、仓位管理和资金管理均不适用，因为该EA不执行任何交易操作。EA的核心逻辑是通过EventSetTimer设置1秒间隔的定时器，在OnTimer回调中调用CLoongClock对象的Timer方法刷新时钟显示，并调用ChartRedraw重绘图表。通过枚举参数ENUM_TIME_FUNC可选择使用本地时间(TIME_FUNC_LOCAL)或服务器时间来驱动时钟显示。整体实现非常简洁，将时钟渲染逻辑封装在CLoongClock类中，主文件仅负责初始化、定时器调度和清理工作。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA does not involve any trading strategy; it is a pure utility EA designed to display a clock on the chart. Entry conditions, exit conditions, position sizing, and money management are all not applicable since the EA does not execute any trading operations. The core logic uses EventSetTimer to set a 1-second interval timer, and the OnTimer callback invokes the CLoongClock object's Timer method to refresh the clock display, followed by ChartRedraw to repaint the chart. Through the ENUM_TIME_FUNC enumeration parameter, users can choose between local time (TIME_FUNC_LOCAL) or server time to drive the clock display. The overall implementation is very clean, encapsulating the clock rendering logic in the CLoongClock class while the main file handles only initialization, timer dispatch, and cleanup.

parameters.name: inp_tf
parameters.description: 时间函数类型，选择使用本地时间或服务器时间显示时钟
parameters.description_en: Time function type: local time or server time for clock display

pros: 代码结构清晰，将时钟逻辑封装在CLoongClock类中，实现了良好的分离
支持本地时间和服务器时间两种时间源切换，灵活实用
使用EventSetTimer定时器机制，不依赖tick事件，在无行情时也能正常刷新
pros_en: Clean code architecture with clock logic encapsulated in the CLoongClock class, achieving good separation of concerns
Supports switching between local time and server time sources, providing flexibility
Uses EventSetTimer mechanism instead of relying on tick events, so the clock refreshes even when no quotes arrive
cons: OnTick函数为空，可能产生不必要的函数调用开销
仅有一个参数，缺少外观自定义选项如颜色、字体、位置等
依赖外部头文件CLoongClock.mqh，无法独立评估完整功能和潜在问题
cons_en: OnTick function is empty, potentially causing unnecessary function call overhead
Only one input parameter; lacks appearance customization options such as color, font, position, etc.
Depends on external header file CLoongClock.mqh, making it impossible to independently evaluate full functionality and potential issues
improvements: 增加时钟外观自定义参数，如颜色、字体大小、显示位置、12/24小时制等
移除空的OnTick函数或在其中添加有用逻辑以减少无效回调开销
improvements_en: Add appearance customization parameters such as color, font size, display position, 12/24 hour format, etc.
Remove the empty OnTick function or add useful logic to reduce unnecessary callback overhead

risk_points: 此EA为纯工具类，不执行任何交易操作，无交易风险
定时器每秒触发ChartRedraw可能导致高频图表重绘，在低端设备上可能有性能影响
risk_points_en: This EA is purely a utility and does not execute any trading operations, posing no trading risk
The timer triggers ChartRedraw every second which may cause high-frequency chart repainting, potentially impacting performance on low-end devices

summary_en: LoongClock is a non-trading utility EA that displays a clock on the chart. It uses a timer event to update the clock every second and supports both local and server time sources via a configurable input parameter.
